snippet.title: North Pole Workshop - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
BIGG Studios is happy to announce the release date of North Pole Workshop. Explore the magical North Pole Workshop in this festive co-op toy-making game for one to four players. Team up with your fellow elves to find efficiencies and speed up production. Craft, wrap, and deliver toys to Santa's sleigh for all the good boys and girls.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3935200/North_Pole_Workshop/
